key_insight: LProp propagates uncertainty through latent representations, allowing downstream LLM agents to revise inherited beliefs rather than treat tentative judgments as facts.
engineering_relevance: The approach offers a token-efficient way to support belief correction in multi-stage LLM workflows without additional trajectory sampling.
method: Estimate uncertainty in latent space without lengthy textual descriptions.
Revise inherited answer distributions using latent representations and new evidence.
Preserve uncertainty-relevant information beyond scalar scores or answer probabilities.
evidence_signal: Across multiple-choice, yes/no, open-ended QA, and mathematical reasoning evaluations, the approach outperforms baselines on most metrics; LProp uses the fewest mean inference tokens in all eight propagation settings, and matched ablations support latent content’s contribution to error recovery.
watch_item: Deployment may require access to model-internal representations; the abstract does not establish compatibility with black-box LLM APIs.
paper_title: LProp: Propagating Latent Uncertainty through Evidence-Conditioned Belief Revision in LLM Agents
